faq.q: What is the median townhome price in Abbotsford?
faq.a: SnapStats does not publish one — it combines condos and townhomes into a single split, whose Abbotsford community median was $497,500 in September 2026 (572 listings, 58 sales, 32 days on market). That combined median is not a townhome figure.

Current listings are in Abbotsford East (Marble Hill Drive in McMillan, and Marshall Road) and Abbotsford West (Simon Avenue). Across the city, Central Abbotsford and Abbotsford West had the most condos and townhomes for sale in September 2026 (256 and 210).

faq.q: Are townhomes in Abbotsford freehold or strata?
faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.

faq.q: What should I check on a townhome in Abbotsford?
faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.
